show.title: Dhananjaya: The Supreme Archer
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/9p7xCb
show.description: After his guru dies saving him, a legendary archer leaves royal fame behind and secretly protects the guru’s daughter, granddaughter, and gurukulam. Living as a humble worker, he silently bears insults while defending them from every threat. When enemies attack and the truth comes out, he reclaims his warrior identity, avenges his guru, and becomes the shield of the gurukulam.
